text: {"status":"CONFLICT","claims":[{"text":"Restricted information must never be stored in personal cloud storage.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"Confidential and Restricted information must never be stored in personal cloud storage."},{"text":"Restricted information may only be stored in company-managed systems approved by Information Security and must never be stored in personal cloud-storage accounts.","evidence_id":"E3","quote":"Confidential and Restricted information may only be stored in company-managed systems approved by Information Security. It must never be stored on personal devices or in personal accounts, including personal email and personal cloud-storage accounts."},{"text":"Credentials and secrets are Restricted information.","evidence_id":"E5","quote":"It includes protected health information (PHI), payment card data, authentication credentials and secrets, and information about planned mergers and acquisitions."},{"text":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account is prohibited.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account, such as a personal Dropbox, personal Google Drive or personal OneDrive, is prohibited."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":["E1","E2"],"conflict_note":"E1 prohibits uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account, while E2 allows Internal information in personal cloud storage when protected with multi-factor authentication; for Restricted information, both sources prohibit it."}
